title: The River That Kept Rising
old_p1: In a vision, a picture from Heavenly Father, Ezekiel saw the temple. A temple is Heavenly Father’s holy house. A little stream came trickling out from under the temple door, flowing east.
A man with a measuring line walked Ezekiel into the water. First it came up to his ankles. Then his knees. Then his waist!
old_p2: Soon it was a deep river, too deep to walk across. Trees grew along both sides. Their fruit was good to eat, and their leaves could help people get well.

That land was hot and dry, and plants need water. So the river showed how Heavenly Father’s goodness brings life everywhere it goes. Later, Jesus offered “living water,” His gift that keeps us alive inside.
Tonight you can feel calm, like floating on a gentle river, safe in His care.
p1: In a vision, Ezekiel saw Heavenly Father’s holy house, the temple. A little stream came out from under its door.
A man walked Ezekiel into the water. First it reached his ankles. Ezekiel kept walking in. Then his knees. Then his waist!
Soon it was a river too deep to walk across. You would have to swim!
p2: Everywhere the river went, things came alive. Fish swam in it. Trees grew beside it, with fruit to eat and leaves to help sick people. That land was a dry desert, so water meant life. Heavenly Father’s goodness brings life like that.
His goodness can grow in you, like that little stream. Tonight, wiggle your toes like you are wading. Think of one good thing He gave you.
